comment: Ultra-light preamp gain for a physical clean amp or NAM input. Pure gain only; no internal clipping or auto-level. Put before the amp/NAM.

params.name: Gain
params.comment: 0..+18 dB. Quadratic gain law for finer low-end control. Unity at 0.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Post-boost trim, 0..100%. Keep at 100 when the goal is to drive the amp/NAM harder.
